notes.title: ■ Ver1.0.1 Update □
notes.notes:
Ver1.0.1 update includes the following:
■ New Stages and Functions

 50 new stages have been added!
  We hope you enjoy them!
Select stages in groups of 5.


□ Technical Changes

Some achievement names have been changed.
The stage select animation has been shortened for quick stage selection. 


■ Bug Fixes

Made the switch more responsive when pressed.
Fixed an issue where the character would not frighten when crouching and switching to puzzle mode.
Fixed a rare issue where if the goal was hidden and open, the character could enter it but would die.
